contract: POST /tools/item/:id/encode-m4b (ApiRouter.js:302) behind the admin middleware (ToolsController.js:159-178): anonymous 401, non-admin 403 before the item lookup, unknown or podcast items 404, books without audio 400 with the client-shown message.
